tool.name: nf-core pirate
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ # Rename .gff3 to .gff if needed find -regex .*\\.gff3\$ | sed 's/3\$//' | xargs -I {} mv {}3 {}
# Run pirate on all .gff in input directory PIRATE \\ $args \\ --threads $task.cpus \\ --input ./ \\ --output ${prefix}_results/
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": pirate: \$( echo \$( PIRATE --version 2>&1) | sed 's/PIRATE //' ) END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
